purpose: development of an FMM estimate-quality gate for four-to-five-pick events

geometry_metrics.directional_geometry: Finite-difference receiver-to-source FMM travel-time gradients are normalized to unit vectors, centered to remove the unknown origin-time direction, then summarized by singular-value condition number and sqrt(trace(pseudoinverse(J_transpose_J))).
geometry_metrics.azimuth: Maximum circular gap in station azimuths as seen from the FMM estimate.

gate_selection.development_subset: Only rows with 4 or 5 valid picks and an available FMM estimate.
gate_selection.validation: Leave one source location out per fold; all noise realizations from the held-out source stay together.
gate_selection.threshold_rule: For each predeclared feature, choose the <= threshold maximizing development success precision among thresholds retaining at least 50% of training rows; ties prefer higher coverage, then lower threshold.
gate_selection.gate_activation_rule: Enable the best feature only if its pooled leave-one-source-out coverage is at least 40% and its precision exceeds the always-accept precision by at least 0.10; otherwise disable quality rejection.

limitations: The development events were used in earlier arrival-picking work. This stage selects a quality-rejection threshold only; the locked-source confirmation is needed to assess generalization.
